chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik ibn Atiyya, from Dawud ibn Farqad, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who bought a mature slave girl, and she did not menstruate with him until six months had passed, and there was no pregnancy in her. He (peace be upon him) said: 'If the likes of her do menstruate, and it is not due to old age, then this is a defect, and you may return her (from the acquisition).'

key_terms.تُرَدُّ مِنْهُ: you may return her (from the sale)
key_terms.جَارِيَةً مُدْرِكَةً: mature slave girl (who has reached puberty)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on returning a slave girl who does not menstruate within six months of purchase?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'ayb' (defect) in commercial transactions by linking the absence of menstruation to a potential loss of fertility or health, provided it is not due to natural aging. It reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on transparency in trade, where hidden defects affecting the utility of the commodity—here, reproductive capacity—grant the buyer the right of return (khiyar al-ayb). The ruling underscores the importance of comparative norms ('if like her menstruates') to distinguish between pathological conditions and individual variance.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik Bin Atiyya, from Dawood Bin Farqad who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who buys an unaware slave girl (not an adult), and she does not menstruate with him until six months pass by for that, and there is no pregnancy with her. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it was such that the likes of her do tend to menstruate, and that does not happen to be due to old age, so that is a fault. You can repudiate from it (they acquisition)’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Malik ibn ‘Atiyyah from Dawud ibn Farqad who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who buys a slave-girl who possesses awareness but does not experience Hayd (menses) while in his possession until six months and she is not pregnant. He (the Imam) said, ‘If slave-girls similar to her experience Hayd (menses) and it is not because of old age, it is a defect and a reason to revoke the contract of sale?”
